title: Protection of piles during installation.
officialText:
Piling shall be handled and installed to the required penetration and resistance
by methods that leave the piles’ strength unimpaired and that develop and retain the piles’ required load-bearing resistance. Any
damaged pile shall be satisfactorily repaired or the pile shall be rejected. As an alternative and subject to the approval by the
commissioner, damaged or misaligned piles or piles not reaching design tip elevation may be used at a reduced fraction of the
design load based on an analysis by the engineer.
